Critical Mass Frankfurt (Friday evening)

Frankfurt, Germany · Critical Mass · Social

Critical Mass Frankfurt (Friday evening) is a Critical Mass ride in Frankfurt, Germany. It rolls second Friday of the month at 7:00 pm local time from Vor der Alten Oper.

How we know

criticalmass.in logs the Sept 11, 2026 ride from the Alte Oper (about 460 riders, 20.1 km), Aug 7 (673 riders), Jul 10 (550) and Jun 12 (220) (fetched Oct 1, 2026).

For visitors

Free, no sign-up and no leader. Friday rides drew 220 to 670 riders in June to September 2026; the Sunday rides 40 to 60. Bring lights.

First time on this ride? Here’s the drill
Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 7:00 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: mass pace, set by the crowd.
Check
Look at their Facebook page the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Critical Mass Frankfurt (Friday evening) group ride

Frankfurt's Critical Mass rolls from the Alte Oper on the second Friday evening, with a smaller Sunday ride at 2:00 pm on the first Sunday. Rides in summer 2026 ran 16 to 24 km. Riders on the platform estimated 460 for Sept 11 and 673 for Aug 7.
